record.paper_title: Current Open Questions in Complete Mixability
record.original_question: Let D_n be the aggregation set of sums X_1 + ⋯ + X_n formed from random variables with prescribed marginal distributions F_1, …, F_n. What are necessary and sufficient conditions for D_n to contain a smallest element with respect to convex order?

evidence.quote: Open Problem 11. What are necessary and sufficient conditions for Dn to contain a smallest element with respect to convex order?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \ge 2$ be an integer and let $F_1, \dots, F_n$ be prescribed (one-dimensional) cumulative distribution functions on $\mathbb{R}$, each with finite mean. Define the aggregation set
$$D_n(F_1, \dots, F_n) = \{X_1 + X_2 + \cdots + X_n : X_i \text{ is a random variable with distribution } F_i,\ i=1,\dots,n\},$$
where the joint distribution of $(X_1, \dots, X_n)$ is allowed to be any coupling of the marginals $F_1, \dots, F_n$ (so $D_n$ is a set of distributions of sums, identified with the laws of $X_1+\cdots+X_n$).

Recall that for two integrable real random variables $Y$ and $Z$, $Y$ is said to precede $Z$ in convex order, written $Y \le_{cx} Z$, if $\mathbb{E}[\phi(Y)] \le \mathbb{E}[\phi(Z)]$ for every convex function $\phi : \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ for which both expectations exist. An element $S^* \in D_n$ is called a smallest element of $D_n$ with respect to convex order if $S^* \le_{cx} S$ for every $S \in D_n$.

Determine necessary and sufficient conditions on the marginals $F_1, \dots, F_n$ for the aggregation set $D_n(F_1, \dots, F_n)$ to contain a smallest element with respect to convex order.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is listed as an open question in the survey on complete mixability and is repeatedly cited as such in subsequent literature. Sufficient conditions are known (e.g., when each F_i has a decreasing density on its support, or in other special cases studied by Bernard–Jiang–Wang and Zhu), but a full characterization of necessary and sufficient conditions for D_n to admit a convex-order smallest element does not appear to have been established.

status_evidence.title: Current open questions in complete mixability
status_evidence.snippet: Open Problem 11. What are necessary and sufficient conditions for D_n to contain a smallest element with respect to convex order?
status_evidence.claim: Listed explicitly as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Two Sufficient Conditions for Convex Ordering on Risk Aggregation
status_evidence.snippet: Sufficient conditions for the existence of a smallest element of D_n in convex order are derived.
status_evidence.claim: Only sufficient conditions, not a full characterization, are available.

status_evidence.title: The complete mixability and convex minimization problems with monotone marginal densities
status_evidence.snippet: For marginals with monotone densities, a smallest element of the aggregation set in convex order is constructed.
status_evidence.claim: Partial sufficient conditions known in special cases.
